title: refactor: simplify magic link logic by removing Used flag
body:
- Removed Used column from MagicLink table and associated default constraint
- Updated token validation logic to rely on ExpiresAt only (time-based expiry)
- Removed unnecessary database update to mark token as used
- Allows users to reuse the same magic link within its expiration window
- Improves UX and reduces edge-case failures (e.g. refresh, failed redirect)
- Ensures one-time token behavior only when needed in future high-security flows

- Wrapped DashboardContent in <Suspense> in page.jsx
